items.briefing:
Australian ed-tech platform Mathspace has disclosed a data breach affecting over one million people, which is directly relevant to anyone who has used the service — including students and educators at training organisations. Separately, the ACSC has warned of critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler products widely used in Australian workplaces; if your organisation uses these, IT teams should apply patches immediately.

With privacy law reform also on the horizon, now is a good time to review how your organisation handles personal data. **Practical tip:** Check whether your organisation uses Citrix NetScaler and confirm with IT that the latest security updates have been applied.
